items.name: tokens
items.title: wmmw design tokens
items.description: Palette humus/bone/or, type scale, spacing, radii and motion tokens (vanilla CSS custom properties). The base every other item assumes.

items.name: editorial-css
items.title: Editorial primitives
items.description: Section heads with mycelium filament underline, sec-intro, arrow links, ruled rows, meta labels. Global CSS on top of the tokens (add the tokens item first).

items.name: terminal-panel
items.title: Terminal panel (legacy)
items.description: Dark surface panel with a mono path header and shell-style typed reveal. Retired from site chrome; kept for articles that quote shell sessions.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical timeline for long-form posts; steps carry optional image banners.

items.name: poll
items.title: Poll
items.description: Local-first single-question poll (localStorage, no backend), trilingual labels.

items.name: math
items.title: Math
items.description: KaTeX formula rendering (display and inline) for MDX posts.

items.name: periodic-table
items.title: Periodic table
items.description: Full periodic table with highlightable elements.

items.name: periodic-column
items.title: Periodic column IVA
items.description: Column IVA extract (carbon to flerovium), trilingual labels.

items.name: annotation-overlay
items.title: Annotation overlay
items.description: Element-click QA feedback overlay (Alt+Y) with its JSONL API endpoint. Gate behind ANNOTATION_SYSTEM=true.

items.name: reports-api
items.title: UUID report publishing
items.description: Bearer-token POST endpoint storing self-contained HTML reports served at /r/<uuid> with noindex. Needs REPORTS_TOKEN and a REPORTS_DIR volume.
